scenario_description:
Objective: Bring the planned squash bisque to tonight's supper-and-story gathering after cooking has already begun.
Emerging Need: The prep attempt moves from ordinary grocery-and-kitchen execution to a stopped batch when the immersion blender fails mid-pot.
Decision Context: Stored borrowing notes identify a privacy-safe, time-limited fallback for this exact kitchen-gear failure without committing anyone else.
Consequence: Timely help could let the same soup batch be finished and transported; once the fallback window closes, the contribution cannot arrive as planned.

parameter.subject: Tonight's soup-and-story timing
parameter.body: Still on for tonight at my place. If you are bringing the squash bisque, the side table will be ready by 6:10 p.m. so we can start ladling before stories at 6:30.

parameter.title: Finish squash bisque for Laurel supper
parameter.description: Roast, blend, pack, and bring the bisque to Laurel's side table before the supper-and-story circle starts.
Squash, stock, cream, and bread for tonight's supper-and-story contribution.

parameter.content: The vegetables are roasted and the bisque is in the pot. I'm blending it now so it can be packed while still warm and be at Laurel's side table by 6:10.
Bad timing: my immersion blender just seized halfway through the pot. The bisque is off heat, still too chunky to serve, and I can't finish this batch for transport without another blender.
I'm locking up and leaving for choir setup now, so I won't be at the porch or checking my phone again until after the circle is underway.
